verdict.rationale: Vue's official docs include a dedicated 'Tutorial' page (vue-docs-11) alongside 'Examples' (vue-docs-12) and 'Quick Start' (vue-docs-10), consistent with Vue's known in-browser, no-setup interactive tutorial; community comments also emphasize the fast, easy learning curve (vue-comm-11, vue-comm-12, vue-comm-15). Missing for 10: explicit description confirming the tutorial runs in-browser without local setup, and independent hands-on corroboration of the tutorial experience itself.
